OCUDU.label: OCUDU gNB stack

writable.name: ssb_block_power_dbm
writable.note: THE incident parameter. 3GPP/schema allows [-60, +50] dBm and the node will accept any of it; this range is the ENVIRONMENT-SAFE window — the span of values this testbed actually runs. It is RU-DEPENDENT: Pegatron runs -11, the TM500 runs +10, the documented default is -16. A value that mismatches the rendered values.yaml is what produced RSRP overflow / high UL BLER. Check the run's RU before pushing. PROVENANCE: this is an O1/YANG **augmentation** leaf (`urn:ocudu-nrcelldu-extension:1.0`), and it is NOT in the Helm-rendered gnb-config.yml — values-pegatron.yaml does not mention it at all. The known-good values therefore come from the O1 blocks of the values-*.yaml files and the working setup, not from the running config ETHOS archives per run (R2). Seeded, not measured (D19).

writable.name: iq_scaling
writable.note: The other half of the RSRP-overflow / UL-BLER incident: fronthaul IQ scaling in the OFH extension container. Observed working values are 5.5-10; the window is 1..20 and provisional. Too high clips, too low buries the signal in quantisation noise — both look like a healthy push and a broken radio. PROVENANCE: like ssb_block_power_dbm, an O1/YANG augmentation leaf absent from the Helm-rendered gnb-config.yml (values-pegatron.yaml does not carry it), so its window is sourced from the values-*.yaml O1 blocks and the working setup — seeded, not measured (D19).

writable.name: administrative_state
writable.note: 3GPP-defined enum, and the value read back from the running cell. LOCKING a cell drops its UEs — legitimate between runs, never during one.

writable.name: pci
writable.note: 3GPP NR PCI range 0..1007; the lab's cells run PCI 0.

writable.name: bandwidth_mhz
writable.note: The charts run 100 MHz (Pegatron and TM500 alike); the audit's CM read showed 80. Only those two are listed. A bandwidth the RU's fronthaul cannot carry is a redeploy question (Mechanism A), not a push.

writable.name: bandwidth_ul_mhz
writable.note: As bandwidth_mhz, uplink side. Keep DL and UL consistent.

not_writable.name: dl_arfcn
not_writable.reason: Retuning a live cell's carrier is not a parameter tweak: it must match the RU's configured band and the fronthaul (the charts run 650000 for Pegatron, 630048 for the TM500). Change it in the rendered config and redeploy (Mechanism A).

not_writable.name: arfcn_ul
not_writable.reason: As dl_arfcn — carrier changes are a redeploy, not a CM write.

not_writable.name: common_scs
not_writable.reason: Numerology is fixed at bring-up: it changes the frame structure the RU and the DU agreed on. Mechanism A.

not_writable.name: tdd_pattern
not_writable.reason: TODO(Ravi): OCUDU expresses TDD as slot counts, not a "DDDSU" string (dl_ul_tx_period 10, nof_dl_slots 7, nof_dl_symbols 6, nof_ul_slots 2, nof_ul_symbols 4). A change re-times the fronthaul against the RU and the PTP domain, so no safe combination has been established — add the individual leaves here once one has.

not_writable.name: nof_antennas_dl
not_writable.reason: TODO(Ravi): antenna count is tied to the RU's port map and the DPDK port lists (Pegatron 4x4, TM500 2x2). Changing it live has not been tried; it is a redeploy today.

OCUDU.note: Cell tuning lives in the vendor augmentation `urn:ocudu-nrcelldu-extension:1.0`, in per-topic sub-containers (`ocudu_nrcelldu_ssb_extensions`, `..._ofh_extensions`, `..._base_extensions`, `..._tdd_extensions`). The 3GPP leaves (`administrativeState`, `nRPCI`, `arfcnDL/UL`, `bSChannelBwDL/UL`, `ssbFrequency`) sit directly under NRCellDU/attributes.

OAI.label: OpenAirInterface gNB stack
OAI.note: TODO(Ravi): no OAI CM write is wired. OAI's O1 adapter has not been observed on this SMO (it has no confirmed cell FDN either — see compatibility.yaml), and its parameter names differ from OCUDU's (`absoluteFrequencySSB` rather than `dl_arfcn`, no `urn:ocudu-nrcelldu-extension:1.0` tree at all). Until the names, paths and safe windows are confirmed, every CM write for an OAI run is REFUSED — which is the point: sending OCUDU's names to an OAI node would either fail obscurely or, worse, hit a leaf that means something else.

ssb_frequency.warning: Both are NR-ARFCNs, but they are not the same number and not the same cell: OCUDU runs 650000, OAI 649920. Never copy one to the other.

band.warning: The value happens to match today (78 on both), which is exactly when a copied value stops being noticed. Still per stack.

channel_bandwidth.warning: ⚠️ UNITS DIFFER: OCUDU states MHz (100), OAI states PRBs (273). OCUDU's 100 written to OAI's dl_carrierBandwidth would configure a 100-PRB cell and look entirely valid. Define OAI's range in PRBs, from OAI's config.

scs.warning: ⚠️ ENCODING DIFFERS: OCUDU states kHz (30), OAI states the SCS *index* (1 = 30 kHz). OCUDU's 30 in OAI's dl_subcarrierSpacing is not 30 kHz — it is not a valid numerology index at all.

ssb_power.warning: ⚠️ DIFFERENT LEAF, DIFFERENT WINDOW: OCUDU's ssb_block_power_dbm is a vendor-extension leaf running -11 (Pegatron) / +10 (TM500); OAI's ssPBCH_BlockPower is a servingCellConfigCommon leaf running -10. When OAI is wired, centre ITS range on ITS value — never inherit OCUDU's -16..10.

iq_scaling.warning: An OCUDU OFH vendor-extension leaf. OAI's FHI 7.2 stack does not expose an equivalent in its config; do not assume one.

pci.warning: Same 3GPP meaning and range; still validated per stack.

prach_config_index.warning: Both index the same 3GPP table and both run 148 today — which is why a copied value would go unnoticed if the tables ever diverged.

administrative_state.warning: 3GPP-common leaf; still resolved and validated per stack.
